results.question: I am going to a 4 day conference in Europe for work. How early must I request the leave, and what daily allowance do I get?
facts: request at least 14 days in advance
results.answer: Leave of 3 days or more must be requested at least 14 days in advance, so a 4-day absence needs 14 days' notice. [1] The daily allowance for travel to Europe is 400 dirhams per travel day. [2] No daily allowance is paid for days when the host provides full meals. [2]
results.not_covered: The sources do not say whether a work conference counts as leave, so the 14-day leave rule may not apply to a business trip. Business travel instead needs department head approval at least 10 working days before travel, plus CEO approval for trips outside the UAE.
